data.notes: Page is a general Augsburg financial aid page listing many awards; the named American Indian Recognition Full Tuition Program has no stated eligibility criteria beyond 'eligible students', no degree level, deadline, or enrollment status. It covers all remaining tuition and fees after federal and state gift aid, starting Fall 2022, and points to a separate program website not provided. Host country USA is inferred from the page's references to FAFSA, Pell Grant and state grants, not from an explicit statement. Other listed awards (Early Auggie, Transfer Regents, Augsburg Possible, Augsburg Family Scholars, Phi Theta Kappa) are not the subject of this record.
